title: the BUILDME entry gate carries a lane that asks the component-boundary judge
intention: inspect_entry in transitions.py has a lane the_ticket_builds_only_inside_its_component that asks build_inspector's buildme_stays_in_its_component over the inspect wire, so a crossing into BUILDME is refused with every foreign write named in the first pass.
why: The parent ticket's judge measures; this lane is where it becomes a refusal. It is a separate ticket because the lane lives in cairn/tools/base and the judge in cairn/machines/build_inspector, and the rule under build forbids one ticket writing both (RULE 1). The lane rides _judge, the same way the five neighbouring lanes do (transitions.py:1054-1065).
how: One _sieve_lane line in inspect_entry after the outline lane, the judge named with _judge; a tooth over a scratch ticket store and commons that crosses into BUILDME with a crossing write (refused, finding named) and without (admitted). Red-first.

the same crossing for a ticket that writes only inside its component is admitted
